newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai starts offshore oil, gas project.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai starts offshore oil, gas project.

text.p: Work has begun on a five billion yuan offshore project to pipe natural gas and oil to Shanghai and other areas of eastern China, the Liberation Daily said on Tuesday.
The first phase of the Pinghu project will cover 20 square km of a total project area of 240 square km in the East China Sea, about 420 km southeast of Shanghai, it said.
Due for completion in December 1998, the underwater pipe will bring 1.2 million cubic metres of high-quality gas a day to a gas treatment plant southwest of Shanghai.
Another pipe will bring high-quality oil to an oil depot on Daishan island off the port of Ningbo, it said.
The investment came from Shanghai, the Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources and the China National Offshore Oil Corporation, it said.

The three parties have set up a joint venture, the Shanghai Oil and Gas Corp, to manage the project, which includes an offshore platform, oil and gas wells, oil pipe, a gas plant, and a crude oil boosting station, it said. It gave no more details.
